title: fix(ui): show app updates outside the conversation
body:
## Update toast demo

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c8c3023c-9305-46c1-9e3d-7a89228c3f4e

43-second WebUI recording with a test Gateway: `/update`, preparation, progress, restart, reconnection, success and failure. The failure stays visible until dismissed and does not return after reload.

## What changed
Update acknowledgments from a WebUI or desktop conversation were rendered as English, emoji-prefixed assistant messages. Route these lifecycle notices through the existing durable update record and show one persistent top-right toast. It shows preparation, the active phase, reconnection, and the outcome without a timeout. The result can be dismissed or opened in Settings → Updates.

The Gateway records the presentation choice from the admitted transport rather than message content. Native iOS/Android, third-party channels, and unclassified callers retain their existing delivery. The toast uses Control UI localization; new strings fall back to English until catalog refresh. No database migration.

## Evidence
- Build-backed Chromium test for preparation, processing, reconnect, failure, no timeout, explicit dismissal, and reload. Synthetic Gateway; [clean and annotated before/after screenshots](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/203357#issuecomment-7071081389).
- Gateway acknowledgement, restart sentinel, and notice suites: 76 passed; the browser/macOS/iOS routing cases were rerun after mechanically extracting the helper. Slash update command suite: 16 passed.
- Core/UI types, focused oxlint and formatter, i18n verification, and `git diff --check` passed. Independent Codex autoreview of the production patch reported no P0–P2 findings.

Draft: no native desktop end-to-end run, real provider-mediated update, or stable-version upgrade was performed. Nothing was deployed.

## Maintainer verification

An isolated Gateway and production Chromium build passed notification progress, an actual Gateway restart and reconnect, persistent success and failure, dismissal across reload, Updates navigation, and a replacement Gateway without a stale notification. These runs used synthetic update records; no installed updater or live deployment was run.

A late immutable-install refusal now publishes its terminal receipt to the same app notification without adding a chat reply. The pre-admission and API paths retain their behavior. The affected Gateway suites, CI test typecheck, lint, and independent review passed after the repair.
